text: Classic Colonial charm on the Dorchester / Mattapan line = exceptional value! The first floor flows from a sunny living room with a fireplace and gleaming hardwood floors into one big kitchen and dining space, with cherry cabinets, stainless steel appliances, a double oven range and room for a full table this holiday season (chandelier included). Laundry is on the main floor and tucked away across from the half bath. A first-floor bonus room is ready to be a study, library, office or game room, whatever suits you. Upstairs, the bedrooms are bright and generously sized, and the full bath features a round soaking tub for those long, well-earned unwinds. The primary bedroom has French doors that open out to a small deck, perfect for morning coffee while grabbing your Vitamin D and taking in views of Blue Hills. Keep climbing and you'll find a finished top floor with plenty of options for a bedroom, playroom or hangout space. The basement has a French drain, waterproofing, double sump pumps and an alarm system, all installed in 2018 for extra peace of mind. Outside, the large, level lot gives you off-street parking for multiple cars, a shed for yard tools and bikes, and plenty of open space for cookouts, gardening or playing your favorite sports. All in a fantastic location! Lower Mills shops and restaurants are less than half a mile away; the Dorchester Park, Walsh Playground, and the red line's Ashmont Station is under a mile; and, within two miles get your fill of nature and fresh air at the Neponset River Reservation. Come see it and make it yours!

Situated in one of Boston's most iconic neighborhoods, Chestnut Hill, this fully renovated, sprawling ranch-style home lives like new construction, blending modern luxury with a super contemporary flare. Perfect for families looking for proximity to the Dexter School, Park School, The British School, Beaver Country Day and Brimmer & May School. The home features four bedrooms, plus a dedicated gym and sauna. The stylish kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, sleek finishes, and an open-concept layout flowing seamlessly into the living room, anchored by a striking Frank Lloyd Wright-inspired fireplace.Three generously sized bedrooms feature custom built-ins, complemented by an expansive laundry room and a beautifully appointed bathroom with a double vanity. The private primary suite offers a luxurious retreat with a private bathroom including solid stone surround, glass enclosed shower with jets and soaking tub complimented by contemporary style fixtures with a custom walk-in closet.The finished lower level adds exceptional versatility, with heated floors throughout, a full bathroom & bedroom, additional space for recreation, fitness, spa like treatment in your indoor built-in sauna and a massive addtional living space perfect for an entertainment area. Outside, enjoy a private patio and abundant green space on a desirable corner lot, along with a spacious two-car garage and an irrigation system. A rare opportunity to enjoy the feel of new construction in one of Boston's most sought-after neighborhoods.
